first.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ, the most acute signal. Memory_91 demonstrated that activation messaging inside the product improved week-one engagement and nudged accounts to first meaningful action. Memory_86 shows onboarding shortening lifted adoption. While promotional_pricing addresses the competitive threat, it risks margin compression and doesn't address the core activation decline. Activation_messaging is proven, directly targets the measured problem, and preserves optionality for pricing response if needed. Verification of memory_31 and memory_91 will confirm the magnitude and durability of past activation gains before deploying similar mechanisms at scale.
